title: A Sacred Journey
overview: When Juan Quintero is diagnosed with Amyotrophic Lateral Schlorosis and given a three year prognosis, his brother and best friend Ernesto must face his shadows and addiction as he comes to the aid of his brother. Together, as they seek to answer what is a life worth living, Juan and Ernesto discover a renewed faith in love, family and community and how we all come together to support the ones we love.
